spans.s: लिप् vt. 6U (pp. लिप्त; pres. लिंपति-ते) 1. To anoint, to besmear, Bt.xix.11; 2. to cover, to spread over; 3. to inflame, to kindle, तस्यालिपत शोकाग्निः स्वांतं काष्ठमिव ज्वलन् Bt.vi.22; 4. to stain, to pollute, to contaminate, न मां कर्माणि लिंपंति Bg.iv.14.With अनु-, 1. to besmear, to anoint, वपुरन्वलिप्त परिरंभसुखव्यवधानभीरुकतया न वधूः Sis.ix.51; 2. to cover, to envelop, R.x.10.With अव-, 1. to smear, to anoint; 2. (pass.) to be puffed up.With आ-, 1. to anoint, to besmear; 2. to contaminate.With चि-, to anoint, to besmear, Bt.iii.20, K.S.v.79.

लिपि(पी) f. 1. Anointing, besmearing; 2. writing, transcribing; 3. painting, drawing; 4. alphabet, लिपेर्यथावद्ग्र्हणेन वाङ्मयं नदीमुखेनेव समुद्रेमाविशत् R.iii.28, xviii.46; 5. a document, a letter, a manuscript, a writing, लिपिं ललाटेऽर्थिजनस्य जाग्रतीम् Na.i.35, 138.
